5 questions — Choose and place the controls that detect a physical attack at Delmar Applied Optics
Xtensr Research Labs · Delmar Applied Optics

Xtensr Research Labs is acquiring Delmar Applied Optics. Xtensr’s physical security team has already assessed Delmar’s vulnerabilities and recommended controls to prevent, deter and correct them. What is left is detection: deciding which controls reveal an attack that is under way or has already happened, and where each one has to sit to do that. The building is the same one — a finished-lens vault off the main corridor, an engineering file server on a shelf in an unlocked utility closet, a reception PC in an open area, an unlocked badge controller cabinet in the lobby, a testing bay, and a ground-floor optics bay below street grade.
